Definition: the tenth multiple of G1803; sixty:--sixty(-fold), threescore.
BiblicalUsage: I take hexḗkonta to mean sixty, threescore, nothing more and nothing less. It occurs 9 times, and Matthew and Mark show it doing ordinary work in ordinary sentences. The Bible uses plain words plainly, and this is one of them.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that hexḗkonta matters because God speaks plainly, and plain words carry real weight. My position is that Scripture does not hide its meaning from honest readers.
RelatedEvents: The Parable of the Sower; The Road to Emmaus
